shop.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE finished premium game UI concept screenshot for the existing Chinese top-down roguelite HEXBLAST: the lobby's 军需商店 (permanent core-coin shop). This is an art direction proposal with illustrative sample data, NOT a web page, NOT wireframe. WIDE 16:9 landscape 1920x1080 composition, one single screen, every edge fully inside image.
Input reference 1 (hero selection screenshot) locks the actual game's UI palette, accessible Chinese typography, dark blue slate panels, short chamfer buttons and bold outlined 2D cartoon illustration. Input reference 2 (abandoned industrial street) locks environmental drawing, chunky machinery, cool desaturated blue-gray metal, selective warm ochre hazard details. Match this precise existing game, with polished hand-illustrated cel shaded industrial surfaces and crisp black contours. Do NOT introduce photorealism, ornate medieval gold fantasy, mobile casino gloss, complex cyberpunk neon, gritty realistic scratches, tiny text, web dashboard white backgrounds.
ART DIRECTION: an indoor quartermaster supply depot belonging to this industrial wasteland world. Structural side pillars LEFT and RIGHT joined by one substantial BOTTOM counter/rail form a highly legible U-SHAPED METAL ENCLOSURE around the shopping content. Side frames approximately outer 5% each, bottom 7%. Clearly drawn beveled gunmetal, chunky mechanical joints, sparse bolts, little cyan inset energy lamps, subdued yellow-black hazard marks at bottom corners. Keep visual noise on periphery. Header remains lighter and open. Environment subtly visible behind calm near-opaque dark slate display cards. No merchant character. The item's art and purchase action dominate, with tasteful warm reward-gold accents. Cyan #23d7e8, panel #1b3046, deep #142235, text #eef4fa.
LAYOUT: safe margins about 60px. Top header: small left arrow button “返回大厅”, large title “军需商店”, modest sibling navigation “装备库”, top-right core-coin currency hex-coin icon and “核心币 1,280”. Below title short subtitle “装备永久入仓 · 战备补给下一局生效”. Main area uses FOUR large polished product cards in generous 2 columns by 2 rows, from roughly x=140..1780 y=220..865. Each card has a large distinct illustrated physical item on left 35%, name and 2 short readable description lines right, substantial clearly aligned purchase button at bottom right. Cards designed as integrated dark steel merchandising trays, NOT text-only rectangles. Active purchase uses cyan rim and calm blue metal fill, gold currency numbers.
CARD 1: cyan-lit chunky equipment chest with oversized hexagonal locking core, title “装备箱”, small classification “永久装备”, copy “随机获得一件未拥有装备” and “品质上限随通关进度提升”, price button “购买 60”.
CARD 2: open industrial lockbox filled with warm golden hex coins, title “战备金库”, small classification “下局生效”, copy “开局金币 +150” and “可重复购买 · 叠加生效”, price button “购买 25”.
CARD 3: three physical cyan holographic intel cartridges fanned like data cards, title “战备情报”, small classification “下局生效”, copy “海克斯三选一连抽 +3” and “可重复购买 · 叠加生效”, price button “购买 40”.
CARD 4: compact cyan shield emitter projecting a clear hex-shaped energy shield, title “战备护盾”, small classification “下局生效”, copy “开局护盾 +60” and “可重复购买 · 叠加生效”, price button “购买 30”.
Above the solid bottom frame place a SINGLE slim horizontal pending supply summary inset, clearly legible: “已购战备” then small icon + “金币 +300” then icon + “连抽 +3” then icon + “护盾 +60”. On bottom frame discreet small label “展示数据 · 美术概念稿”.
Chinese must be clean and accurate, large hierarchy suited for original 1280x720 game. Currency core coins distinct from starting run gold. Plenty of breathing room, minimal descriptive text, strong icon silhouettes. Every title and price fully visible. Draw as a credible high quality finished game screen, no exterior device mockup, no extra panels, no watermark.

armory.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE premium finished game UI concept screenshot for HEXBLAST's Chinese “装备库” screen, with plausible sample equipment for visual review. WIDE 16:9 landscape 1920x1080 single full screen, nothing cropped.
INPUT IMAGES: reference 1 is the just-approved-for-style SHOP CONCEPT in this pair, use its precise industrial framing language, 2D outlined machinery, navy metal, cyan fixtures, typography, coin design, chamfer buttons. It is a STYLE reference, create a DIFFERENT armory layout rather than editing the shop labels. Reference 2 is the existing actual game hero-selection UI; it anchors the same bold cartoon cel shading and calm dark slate surfaces. No realistic render, no medieval inventory scrolls, no mobile casino gloss, no new art style.
ENVIRONMENT: inside the same blue-gray wasteland depot, this side is a tidy equipment vault/workbench. Same solid metal U-SHAPED enclosure: substantial left/right vertical structural pillars and joined bottom rail with modest cyan lamps, restrained ochre corner hazard marks; generous central space, quiet navy near-opaque panels. Hand-drawn beveled metal in two/three cel tones, thick controlled dark outlines. Peripheral shelving subtle, background calm. No people or hero portraits, no weapon loadout body diagram. Equipment are passive stat modules (reactor, armor plate, propulsion unit, targeting scope, gold pickup magnet).
HEADER to match shop: upper-left “返回大厅” arrow button, large central “装备库” with small sibling nav “军需商店”, upper-right SAME hex currency icon “核心币 1,280”. Subtitle “跨局装备 · 最多携带 3 件出战”.
LAYOUT: from x=115..1285 main left zone ~66%, right detail zone x=1320..1800 ~27%, breathing room. Outer frame at 4% edges. Main left zone has equipped slots TOP, collection grid BOTTOM. Single right inspection panel from y=220..960. Header at y=50..170.
EQUIPPED SLOTS: readable section title “出战配装 3/3”. Beneath it exactly THREE horizontally arranged compact cards with icon at left, name and passive stat at right, small “卸下” below. Slot 01 EPIC “火力核心” with compact purple/cyan power reactor icon, “伤害 +10%”; slot 02 EPIC “强化装甲” thick armor plate, “生命 +12%”; slot 03 EPIC “瞄准镜” circular red-lens optical scope with blue housing, “暴击率 +6%”. Purple rarity edges discreet, cyan small “已出战” tags. Three slots and icons must all be fully visible.
COLLECTION below: section heading “装备仓库 10/15”, small horizontal filter chips “全部” selected in cyan, “普通”, “稀有”, “史诗”. EXACTLY TEN item cells in FIVE columns TWO rows, with generous 20px gutters, clear item art above and name / single stat below. Common gray edge, rare blue edge, epic purple edge, never use color alone: show small quality word. No purchase button in inventory grid; selection opens detail on right. Three equipped items are identified by tiny cyan “已出战” tags, selected first firepower-core card has restrained brighter cyan outline plus purple rarity accent. Specific ten cells:
row1 epic “火力核心” “伤害 +10%” selected/equipped; epic “强化装甲” “生命 +12%” equipped; epic “瞄准镜” “暴击率 +6%” equipped; rare “推进器” “移速 +6%”; rare “吸金器” “拾取范围 +30”.
row2 rare “火力核心” “伤害 +6%”; rare “强化装甲” “生命 +8%”; common “推进器” “移速 +3%”; common “瞄准镜” “暴击率 +2%”; common “吸金器” “拾取范围 +15”.
The five affix types have distinctive tangible illustrated module silhouettes, matching same kind across different qualities. Grid icons remain colorful and clear, NO guns pretending to be armor modules.
RIGHT INSPECTION: clean integrated solid panel with small top “装备详情”, purple rarity pill “史诗”, large beautifully illustrated single firepower reactor hovering subtly above a simple lit workbench, hex cyan energy center and purple ring, NOT a jewelry orb. Big name “火力核心”, primary stat in cyan “伤害 +10%”, simple line “纯属性加成 · 跨局保留”, status “已装备于出战槽 01”. Bottom actions one large calm cyan button “卸下装备” and one subdued outlined button with warm coin icon “卖出 90 核心币”. Do NOT invent crafting, upgrading, item levels or extra abilities. Currency sale sample 90 corresponds existing epic value 450 x 20%. Avoid delete icon. Tiny footnote on bottom rail “展示数据 · 美术概念稿”.
DESIGN PRIORITY: clear hierarchy, readable Chinese at actual 1280x720 game scale, concise exact text, plenty of negative space, item illustrations and selected-item detail are visual focus. Keep U frame contained around screen, structural matching the shop reference but don't let machinery invade usable content. Make this a genuinely finished, thoughtfully art-directed sibling screen. No multi-screen collage, no exterior laptop or phone, no extra invented labels, no watermark.
